name: rasa.module.crm
description: The address book, the customer accounts and the sales funnel, one record per file: vCard 4.0-aligned contact cards for every person and organization (CARD-nnnn; a card needs no account), accounts as the customer hub (acct-<slug>, the file name is the id; this module owns the account registry), and leads that move through declared stages (LEAD-nnnn; the stage is the directory) to won — which makes the account a current customer in the same act — or lost, with the reason. vCard 3.0/4.0 import with dedupe and vCard 4.0 export. Built to the records-family/1 standard shared with rasa.module.notes, rasa.module.schedule and rasa.module.messages: a strict-YAML frontmatter grammar, JSON Schemas as the field law, an atomic CLI (.claude/bin/crm) that writes every change with an append-only history line, and a validator (.claude/bin/check-crm) that enforces every numbered invariant. What varies per business — what 'qualified' means, each stage, what 'active customer' and churn mean, what may be recorded about a person — is delegated to the project-owned .claude/crm-gate.md seam and crm/crm.config.yml; qualifying a lead hard-stops until the criteria are declared.

rasa.note: v0.2.0 FOLDS contacts into this module (owner decision 2026-09-28): the Contact becomes the vCard 4.0 (RFC 6350) aligned address book for ALL people and organizations — a contact no longer needs an account — while the Account (the customer hub) and the Lead (the sales funnel) are kept and re-stored to the same standard. Records: CARD-nnnn in crm/contacts/ (archived and merged-away cards in crm/contacts/_archive/), acct-<slug> in crm/accounts/<id>.md (the one slug-keyed record in the family), LEAD-nnnn in crm/leads/<stage>/ (the directory is the stage). The contact prefix is CARD, not CON: rasa.module.contracts already mints CON-nnn. DELIBERATE DIVERGENCE (kept from 0.1.0): the split business-ops modules (leads / contracts / invoices / field-log) treat @acct-<slug> as an opaque join key and keep no account records; rasa.module.crm OWNS the account registry and is the accounts source of truth when mounted. KEY LIFECYCLE LINK: `crm lead win` closes the lead and moves its account to the active status in one act (two records, two history lines); lost is terminal and keeps its reason. HARD-STOP: `crm lead advance` into the qualified stage refuses until config `qualification` is declared and every criterion is asserted with --met. Built to the rasa.module.tasks v1.0.0 standard: numbered invariants (F-01..F-27 family, C-01..C-16 crm), JSON Schemas under .claude/schemas/crm/, one atomic CLI, an append-only crm/history.tsv, and a validator. records.py (the family core) is byte-identical across notes/schedule/crm/messages; bin/check-manifest proves it. Removed on the module.tasks v1.0.0 precedent: the /sync /promote /whoami skills, the identity stamp and the rasa-deployment seed. Interop is files (.vcf); no tool opens a network connection. Cross-references into notes/schedule/messages/tasks and to contracts/invoices/field-log are SOFT: resolved when mounted, never requires.elements[].

identity.one_liner: the RasaOS module for the address book, customer accounts and the sales funnel
identity.subject: contacts, accounts and leads
identity.goal: bring an address book, a customer registry and a sales funnel into a project as an installable RasaOS module

element.description: Element-owned files mirrored into the install target per canon ELEMENT_CONTRACT.md §7. Refreshed on every Element upgrade, so nothing here holds project state. The seam, the config and the crm/ ledger are NOT here — they are project-owned (see seed.files).

files.note: The law: the records-family/1 conventions (identical in all four family modules) followed by the crm law — the contact card, the account hub and the registry this module owns, the lead and the funnel, qualification, won -> active, views, vCard interop. Every rule is marked with its invariant id or 'judgement'.
JSON Schemas (draft 2020-12 subset) for the contact card, the account, the lead and crm.config.yml. Both the interop artifact and the enforced field law: records.py evaluates them.
The three crm skills — /contact, /account, /lead. Only names inside this module's vocabulary: directory-mirror overwrites same-named skills silently.

The two programs (crm, check-crm) and their package rasa_crm/ (records.py family core, model, fields, vcard, validate, cli, FAMILY). Pure standard library; no network, no version control. Overlays .claude/bin/ without deleting other modules' programs.
What this module ships and where each file lands. Author-time; not installed.
The design record: why contacts were folded in, the records-family/1 design, the decisions, the invariant map, what was deferred. Author-time; not installed.

seed.description: One-time, project-owned files copied at install only (skip-if-exists / init-only-with-sha), per canon ELEMENT_CONTRACT.md §7. They belong to the project the moment they land and are never overwritten by an Element upgrade.

files.note: The judgement half of the seam: what 'qualified' means criterion by criterion, each stage's entry and exit, what 'active customer' and churn mean, what may be recorded about a person. The machine half is crm/crm.config.yml.

What the project declares: stages and the won/lost/qualified names, the qualification criteria (the hard-stop), sources, account statuses and the active one, tiers, tags, contact roles, groups, labels, default currency, actors.
The append-only history log, header row only. Written by the crm tool, never by hand.
The address book directory (bin/init does not implement scaffold.directories, so directories ship as placeholders).
The 'new' stage directory of the default funnel. A project that declares other stages creates their directories as leads move.

Stamped with the Element HEAD SHA at init; written only when absent. When co-installed under a parent that stamps its own lockfile, the parent's is authoritative (single-writer-per-path, Lock L-004).
